From the final whistle to a post: match highlights for your club's social pages

24 November 2026 · Kadar

Most amateur clubs post the result on Monday, as a line of text. By then the people who care already know it. The club that posts a clip of the winning goal twenty minutes after the whistle gets the shares, and next week a few more people at the fence.

What to post, and when

  1. Within the hour: the result card. Both crests, the score, the scorers. It is the post people forward to the family group.
  2. The same evening: the best goal. One clip, ten to fifteen seconds, with the scorer's name on it.
  3. The next day: the highlight reel. All the goals and marked moments in one video, for those who missed the stream.
  4. Midweek: the table. Where the club stands, and who is next.

Make the clips while the match is on

Nobody wants to scroll through ninety minutes of video on Sunday night looking for a goal. Mark the moments as they happen. In Kadar every goal you add to the score becomes a clip by itself, and one tap on Highlight marks anything else worth keeping: a save, a red card, a celebration.

When you end the match, the summary is waiting: the clips, all of them joined into one reel, and result cards in four designs. You share them from the phone to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp or Viber, or save them to Photos and post later.

Name the player

A goal clip with "9 · Amar · 23'" on it gets shared by the player, his family and his friends. A clip without a name gets a like. In the clip studio you tap the scorer in the picture, the rest dims and a ring marks him, and the caption plate carries the number, the name, the club and the minute.

Small habits that help

  • Post upright video to stories and wide video to the feed and YouTube.
  • Write the score and the opponent in the first line of the caption.
  • Tag the opponent's page. They share it too, even when they lost.
  • Thank the match sponsor in the post, with their page tagged.
  • Ask parents before posting clips of children's matches.

Highlights, the reel and result cards are free in Kadar. The clip studio with the spotlight and the caption is part of PRO, and everything in PRO is free until 28 February 2027.
